Only the owner of the event can perform this action.

post.description:
Submits a withdrawal request from the organization's wallet to the admin for review.

Rules:
- Only the organization owner can submit a withdrawal request.
- The `walletId` must belong to the authenticated organization.
- The requested `amount` must not exceed the current wallet balance.
- Only one pending withdrawal request is allowed per wallet at a time.
- The `qrString` is the organization's bank/e-wallet QR code that the admin will use to transfer the funds.

400.description: Validation error or insufficient balance

403.description: Forbidden — not an organizer or wallet does not belong to this organization

patch.description:
Approve or reject a withdrawal request.

The organizer's submitted `qrString` is their own personal/business KHQR — it is not
generated by this platform, so there is no Bakong API credential this backend holds
that can be used to auto-verify a payment into it. Because of that, payouts here are
made manually by an admin from their own banking app, and this endpoint requires real
evidence of that transfer rather than a self-reported reference alone.

When approving (`status=Approved`), both `transactionRef` (the bank/Bakong transaction
reference typed in by the admin) and `proof` (a screenshot/receipt image of the
completed transfer) are **required**. Rejecting does not require either field.
This is a multipart request, not JSON.

parameters.name: transactionRef
parameters.description: Bank/Bakong transaction reference. Required when status=Approved

proof.description: Screenshot/receipt proving the transfer completed. Required when status=Approved (image, max 5 MB)

400.description: transactionRef or proof is missing when approving

example.detail: Proof of payment is required when approving a withdrawal
